# Orchamind

> Orchamind is an AI-native operations platform for contractors and field-service businesses — general contractors, electricians, plumbers, HVAC, and roofers. Owners run jobs, crews, hours, materials, estimates, and subcontractors by voice or text, and get a daily AI briefing, risk alerts, and instant answers. Flat $500/month, unlimited seats. Created by Siamak Kalhor.

Orchamind replaces the stack of tools a field business juggles. Instead of the operation living in the owner's head and a hundred text messages, it lives in one system you can talk to like your smartest project manager. Ask "what's at risk this week?" and get a straight answer.

## What Orchamind does

- **Voice-first job management** — say "log 8 hours for Mike at the Johnson job" or "add $4,200 in lumber to Oak Street" and it's done. Type or talk.
- **Daily AI briefing** — every morning: which jobs need attention, who's where, what's at risk, what's over budget.
- **AI estimates with Good-Better-Best** — describe a job in plain English; get an itemized estimate with three priced options that close more work.
- **Dispatch board** — assign crews, track status, see the whole day on one screen.
- **GPS time clock** — crew clock in/out with verified location; accurate hours, no time theft.
- **Client portal and AI updates** — homeowners see progress photos, milestones, invoices, and can message you. Fewer "any news?" calls.
- **Risk radar** — alerts before problems cost money: inspections before you cover up work, budget overruns, missing permits, schedule slips.
- **Job costing** — materials, labor, and expenses per job; see margin erosion in real time, not at tax time.
- **Change orders** — log scope changes by voice the moment they happen so they actually get billed.
- **Website lead widget** — one line of code turns a contractor's site into a lead and booking machine; leads text and email the owner instantly.
- **Online payments** — clients pay by card via Stripe; money goes straight to the contractor's bank.
- **QuickBooks integration** — push job material costs to QuickBooks as vendor bills.

## Who Orchamind is for

Owner-operators and small-to-midsize field businesses (roughly 2-50 people): general contractors, remodelers, electricians, plumbers, HVAC contractors, and roofers. It is built for the owner who is still in the field and cannot afford to run the office from a laptop at 10 p.m.

## Pricing

Flat **$500/month, unlimited seats**. First month free. No card required to start. There is no per-seat pricing — unlike ServiceTitan, Jobber, Housecall Pro, and Buildertrend, which charge per user and get expensive as a crew grows.

## How Orchamind differs

Most contractor software is a database with forms — you still do the work of entering and interpreting everything. Orchamind is AI-native: you talk to it, and it tells you what matters. The AI reads your actual jobs, crew, hours, budgets, and schedule, then answers questions, writes estimates and client updates, and flags risk before it costs money.
